# Awesome Agentic Loops / Agentic Loop Atlas

Use this repository to find and design bounded AI-agent operating loops.

Core rule: motion is not progress; proof is.

Rules for agents:
- Prefer loops with proof, stopping_condition, approval_gate, and cost_guard.
- Do not run destructive, service, credential, billing, deploy, or external-message actions without explicit human approval.
- Start with one bounded iteration.
- End with a receipt and next-loop plan.
- If no loop fits, design a new Loop Card using schemas/loop-card.schema.json.
- Do not treat a draft loop as production-ready until it has a receipt.

Important files:
- README.md — human overview and quick start
- CONTRIBUTING.md — contribution standard
- SECURITY.md — redaction and security policy
- ROADMAP.md — project roadmap
- catalog.json — machine-readable catalog
- schemas/loop-card.schema.json — required fields
- docs/index.html — mini landing page
- docs/announcement-draft.md — ready-to-post announcement draft, not posted
- docs/positioning.md — positioning and contribution standard
- docs/risk-taxonomy.md — safety levels
- docs/platform-matrix.md — agent/runtime compatibility
- loops/ — loop cards
- examples/ — proof receipts
- .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ — GitHub issue templates

Proof-grade seed loops:
- AAL-LOOP-001 — Core Hygiene Sweep
- AAL-LOOP-002 — Docs/README Milestone Sweep
- AAL-LOOP-003 — Production Error Sweep
- AAL-LOOP-004 — Flaky Test Killer
- AAL-LOOP-005 — PR CI Babysitter
- AAL-LOOP-006 — Stale PR Review Resolver
- AAL-LOOP-007 — Security Headers / OWASP Sweep
- AAL-LOOP-008 — Cost Budget Watch Loop
- AAL-LOOP-009 — Research-to-Public-Artifact Loop
- AAL-LOOP-010 — Agent Mesh Health Loop
- AAL-LOOP-011 — Competitor Delta Proof Loop

Launch artifacts:
- docs/index.html — mini landing page
- docs/announcement-draft.md — public announcement draft, not posted
- assets/social-preview.svg — upload manually in GitHub repo settings if GitHub does not pick it automatically.
